tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i

cho ga ngag 'don bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje zla bar rab chags kun rtog rab spangs phyogs kyi gos can ma/ / bden gnyis zung 'jug mchog tu sbyor bas khro zhing 'dod chags nyams brgya'i ros sgeg ma/ /bde chen myos byed bzlos gar bsgyur mkhas he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i nā ḍa ka /bde gshegs kun yum rnal 'byor ma dpal btud nas dpal mo de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di yi bsnyen pa tsam la yang*/ /man ngag gzhan las rtogs bya'i phyir/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i/ /lag len mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /gnas dus bzang por maṇḍal chos 'byung nyis brtsegs rdul tshon gyis bris la/ der mañdzi la ka pā la chang la bdud rtsi sbyar bas bkang*/ me long la sindhū ra bkram/ gser gyi thur mas chos 'byung sogs rang gi snying kha'i sngags 'khor ltar 'bri/ steng nas dar dmar pos bkab/ nang gi gtor ma gnyis dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa rnams g.yon bskor tu bshams/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ rol mo dang*/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ gos zung sogs sgrub mchod kyi yo byad dang*/ bum pa/ dung chos/ gzungs thag chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga ste bum sgrub la dgos pa dang*/ mig dar/ me tog /ting lo/ maṇḍal/ 'bru nas sogs slob ma la dgos pa rnams tshang bar byas la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma ni/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhna pā ya/ gṛhna pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badzra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shuddhoḥ sarba dharmāḥ swa bha wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ ha hoḥhriḥ phaiṃ badzra a ralli ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya ho/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rakṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa/ unma da/ a pasmā ra/ ḍā ka /ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ hṇantu sa ma ya rakṣantu/

ma ma sarba siddhi mme/ pra yatstshantu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thai ṣtaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi ghra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta yaṃ/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi shuddha/ sa ha yi ka bha wantu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ḍā ki ni arghaṃ/ pa dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai bi dyai/ shapta āḥhūṃ/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod spyin tshogs bsog brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/

/las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel dang chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i phyogs skyong rnams kyis ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bar chad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /gang dag nag phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang po rnams gtor ma'i lhag ma 'dis tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig / sum bha drag tu bzlas la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ de nas bsrung ba ni/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba dang*/ oṃ sumbha nas/ badzra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gnyis brjod/ se gol phyogs bcur brdab pa/ tshams rngam lag len bzhin byas la bsrung 'khor du gyur pa mos par ni gnas bsrung ba'o/ /nang mchod sumbhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung dang*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ 'dir lag pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi rol mchod pa spro na byas kyang legs mod/ cho ga'i rim pa la mi dgos so/ /de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal med khang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i dbus su/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab zhal zas rol mo rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las gyur pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ pā dyaṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra gandhe ā hūṃ/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra spha ra khaṃ/ oṃ badzra ghanṭe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe ṭa pra tsa li te pradzñā pā ra mi ta/ nā da saṃ bha wa/ badzra dharma hriḥ da ya/ santo ṣa ṇi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ de nas spro na zhu 'bul bya/ skyabs 'gro ni/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / de nas bdud rtsi myangs la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod/ tshad med ni/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum bya/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bsnyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khoragyi steng du hūṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs/ hūṃ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka /sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su two ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wā na/ badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa twa aḥhūṃ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzad cig

/gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ / 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ / sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas bla ma bsgom pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ / kun gyi byed po bla ma yin*/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ / byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying khar e e yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ yig dmar po/ de'i mthar g.yon bskor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇā nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas/ rang gi lus thams cad gang bas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg sbyangs/ lus kyi gong bur gyur pa'i skad cig las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gam

rdo rje la ḍā ma ru dpyangs pa thur du sdigs pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas gdong gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ mchan khung ngam phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la dril bu g.yer kha dang 'phan lce gsum pa rnams 'phyang bzhin du bsnams pa/ khro chags 'dres pa/ bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sgeg cing mdzes la nu 'bur rgyas shing sked skabs phra ba/ klu shing gi me tog sna lngas brgyan pa'i dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i rang bzhin no/ / de nas dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor la/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying kha'i baṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba ddharmāḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3 haṃ/ de nas 'gro ba dag pa ni/ snying kha'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ ba spu'i bu ga nas byung*/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ yang 'od 'phros/ de rnams dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa mnyes pa byas/

'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsam/ de nas dang por ngag bzlas dang*/ phyi nas yid bzlas bya ste/ snying kha'i sngags 'khor ram gsang ba'am lte bar bsgoms nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /mthar bsam mi khyab ni/ snying kha'i sngags 'phreng las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum 'od kyi rnam par gyur/ tshur 'dus gzugs med khams pa thams cad rang lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams pa thams cad bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams pa thams cad smad kyi cha la thim/ rang yang snying kha'i zla ba la/ de sngags 'phreng la/ de yang baṃ la/ de yang thig le la/ de yang nā dar gyur/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ de la blo bzhag slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ ces brjod spro na mchod bstod cung zad byas la/ mthar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab ste bdag bskyed do/ / de nas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su kaṃ las thod pa dkar bo dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba nang bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du gnas pa'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ e e yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi g.yon du 'khor ba/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po/
de'i mthar g.yon bskor du oṃ oṃ oṃ

nas swāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba las sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ zhes pa nas/ tsaṇḍi ka'i rang bzhin dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūṃ/ phaiṃ nas/ yo ga shuddho?&haṃ gi bar sngar bzhin byed/ thugs ka'i baṃ yig zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus snying kha'i chos kyi yi ge la thim/ de nas bzlas pa byed/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes mgron spyan drangs/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che la dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi tye/ shapta āḥhūṃ/ zhes mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga badzra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/

/sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas/ badzra pādyaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar/ /dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /me tog de ring bzhes nas su/ /'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ nas/ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ tsan dan ga bur dang bcas pa'i/ /dri zhim spos me dge ba yi/ / mthu dang ldan pa bya ba 'di/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ nas/ dhū paṃ= oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba 'di/ /ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms par byed/ /a yig mig 'byed bkra shis pa'i/ /mar me khyed kyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas/ dī paṃ= oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs ga bur rnam brgyan pa/ /sna tshogs yi ge hūṃ las byung*/ /dri 'di 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /gan dhaṃ= /oṃ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ / bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag / 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas/ nai wi dya= oṃ pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs/ /dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang*/ /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs rnams/ / 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ nas/ badzra shapta= gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha re re la yang zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog / oṃ nas/ wast+ra sya= oṃ wī na badzra ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma/ /ston mkha'i mdog mtshungs pi waṃ lag /pi waṃ sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra wī ni badzri ṇi pu dzi te ā hūṃ/

oṃ waṃ se badzri ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo gling bu ma/ /gser gyi mdog can gling bu'i lag /gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= /waṃ se= /oṃ mṛ ti gi badzri ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo rnga zlum ma/ /ban dhu'i mdog can rnga zlum lag /rnga zlum sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab= / mṛ ti gi= /oṃ murdzi= /rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs rdza'i rnga'i lag /rdza rnga'i sgra dang = /nam mkha'= /murdzi= /oṃ hasya= rdo rje lha mo bzhad pa mo/ /ke shu'i mdog mtshungs bzhad pa'i zhal/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin dang dbyangs= nam mkha' khyab= /ha sye= oṃ lā sya= rdo rje lha mo sgeg pa mo/ /dbang sngon mdog mtshungs sgeg pa'i tshul/ /bsnyems pa'i lus dang glur ldan pa/ /nam mkha'= / lā sya= /oṃ gīrti= /rdo rje lha mo glu dbyangs ma/ /'char ka'i mdog mtshungs glu len ma/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra ldan pa/ /nam mkha'= /gīrti= /oṃ nirti= /rdo rje lha mo gar mkhan ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs gar mdzad ma/ /lag pa gar byed rkang stabs sgyur/ /nam mkha'= /nirti= oṃ puṣpe= rdo rje lha mo me tog ma/ / gur kum mdog mtshungs me tog lag /me tog char dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha'= /puṣpe= oṃ dhū pe= rdo rje lha mo bdug spos ma/ /du ba'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos lag /bdug pa'i sprin dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha'= /dhu pe= oṃ dī pe= /rdo rje lha mo mar me ma/ /glog 'od mdog mtshungs mar me'i lag / mar me'i 'od dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha' khyab= /dī pe= /oṃ gan dhe= / rdo rje lha mo dri chab ma/ /pri yang mdog mtshungs dung chos lag /dri yi char dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha= /gan dhe= oṃ rū pa= rdo rje lha mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /ston zla'i mdog mtshungs me long lag /yid 'ong gzugs dang rgyan ldan pa/ /nam mkha= /rū pa= oṃ ra sa= rdo rje lha mo zhal zas ma/ /dza ba'i mdog mtshungs zhal zas lag

/zhal zas bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma/ /ma mkha'= / ra sa= oṃ sparsha= rdo rje lha mo na bza' ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs na bza'i lag /gos dang reg dang 'khyud par ldan/ /nam mkha'= /sparsha= oṃ dharma dhā tu badzrī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo chos dbyings ma/ /kundha'i mdog mtshungs chos 'byung lag /zag pa med pa'i bde ster ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra dharma dhā tu badzri ṇi pū dzi te aḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gī na sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pu dzi te āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /dbul zhing 'phongs pa rgyun chad nas/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog / oṃ nas ma ṇi ratna pu dzi te= /btsun mo= /ma rig mun pa rgyun chad nas/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs te/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wa sti/ / blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ / bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*/ /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog / mahā ta/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal zhing/ / bla med theg pa rab bzhon nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ha sti ratna/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol nas/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob ste/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /tu raṃ ga a shwa ratna/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaṭga ratna= kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ongs rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/

/bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gī na sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pu dzi te āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin dang*/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra dbyangs ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor= /bzhes shig= /shapta kā ma gu ṇa/ phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sprul snying dang*/ /a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos dkyil= /bzhes shig bla= /gandhe/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos= /bzhes shig= /ra sa= /phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos=/ bzhes shig= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra sparsha kā ma gu na pu dzi te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ khyab bdag gar gyi dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje phag mo bde chen bskyed pa'i yum/ /bde stong nyams kyis myos pa'i dril bu pa/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ chang 'tshong mkha' 'gro'i yab gyur ḍeṃ gi pa/ /bar ma'i slob dpon mchog grags rnam rgyal zhabs/ /brtul zhugs rig pa'i rnal 'byor ti lo pa/ / rnam dag= /paṇa grub mkha' spyod gshegs pa'i nā ro pa/ /de sras thu bo pham thing sku mched gnyis/ /skad gnyid smra mkhas lo tsā rnam gnyis la/ /rnam dag= / khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma sa skya pa/ /rig 'dzin mkha' spyod dbang po bsod nams rtse/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan la/

/rnam dag= /dri med mngon par sangs rgyas sa paṇa chen/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /chos brgyad 'ching ba las grol zhang pa la/ /rnam dag= / rtse gcig sgrub pa mthar phyin brag phug pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gdams pa'i gter mdzod dpal ldan tshul khrims la/ /rnam dag= /chos kyi rje bo ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal/ /sdom brtson rdo rje 'dzin mchog ngor chen pa/ /rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug la/ /rnam dag= / rje btsun sbas pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma'i mchog /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dam pa'i rje/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /rnam dag= /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yang na ngor chen pa'i rjes la/ 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen shākya'i mtshan/ / rnam dag= /gzhon nu chos grub byin rlabs yid bzhin gter/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs/ /rnam dag ye shes thugs mnga' rdo rings dbon/ /rnam dag= / yang na chos rje bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su/ nus pa mthar phyin mkhan po sangs rgyas skyabs/ /blo ldan mkhas pa'i rgyal mtshan tshul khrims dang*/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag skam dgon pa/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i sogs gong bzhin/ de bzhin du chos rje bla ma sa skya bu ston/ theg chen chos rje spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ yon tan rgyal mtshan pa/ gzhon nu chos grub man sngar bzhin/ gzhan yang brgyud pa'i khyad par sna tshogs yod pas ji ltar 'dod par sbyar ro/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus don dam dga' bzhi'i dngos/ /brtan g.yo'i snying po gcig gyur gsal mdzad pa/ /brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rnam dag= /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i bla ma/ dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad

kyi/ /yum gyur sgyu 'phrul chen mo bcom ldan ma/ /mkha' spyod gtso mo rdo rje phag mo la/ /rnam bdag= /bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= oṃ grī rā dza grī rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swāhā/ dpa' bo dur khrod kyi bdag po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi= gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi= gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan dho dang nye ba'i tshan dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi= zhing skyong bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi= gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi= /gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag /gzhi bdag /grong bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi= 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da na badzra swa bha wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myangs/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba sogs lan lnga tsam byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/

na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang bdag gi mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya/ ā brta ya ho/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ/ abhi sma ra spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu a ka sha sa manta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri shodha le maṇḍa le/ ma ma pra ni dhi pū ṇye dzña na ba le naṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba le na sapta sā stha na ba len tsa ye swāhā/ de nas bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra wā rā hī waṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ārya a pa ra dzi te trai lo kya ma te mahā bi dye shwa ri ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha ya wa he mahā badzre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ba shyaṃ ka ri ni tra bhra ma nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ka ra li ne hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mast+ra sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzambha ni stambha ni mo ha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ na mo badzra wā rā hī mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i yum gyur bcom ldan ma/ /chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i dngos/ / zag med bde stong lhan cig skyes ma'i sku/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phag mo sna tshogs bde ma dang*/ /bdag med ye shes dbang phyug sna tshogs yum/ /rdo rje sgrol ma ro langs ma la sogs/ /sna tshogs mtshan 'chang khyod la phyag= /e yig dpal ldan padma bha ga dang*/ /gsang ba chos 'byung chos dbyings nam mkha'i khams/ /seng ge'i khri sogs brda thabs du mas mtshon/ /shes rab lha mo'i gtso la= /chos dbyings rang bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ /don dam 'khor 'das srid pa gsum gyi gzugs/ /mtha' yas sprul pa'i snang ba phyogs brgyar 'bar/ /sku yi dbang phyug ma la= /zab mo gsang sngags chos dbyings sgra brgya pa/ /nges tshig ming don rgya mtsho'i 'jug pa can/ / mtha' dag mgon gyi gsung dbyangs rdo rje ma/ /gzhom med lha mo khyod la= /rang bzhin spros bral mi 'gyur chos dbyings ngang*/ /ma lus shes bya'i gnas tshul kun gsal ba/ /kun mkhyen ye shes lhun grub rnam mi rtog /mkha' spyod thugs kyi rdo rjer= /gang gi rnam 'phrul yid bzhin bsgyur mdzad pas/ /dpag yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub mthu dpal can/ /'phrul ldan dbang phyug mnga' bdag rnal 'byor ma/ /sgyu 'phrul bde ba'i gter la= /rdo rje lha mo khyod thugs ye shes dang*/ /sku dang 'phrin las dbyings dang nam mkha' ste/ /'di dag brtan g.yo kun la lhan cig khyab/ /kun khyab kun 'gro'i gtso mor= /kun gzhi rnam dag mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /sna tshogs gnas dang mchod pa'i bkod par bcas/ / zhing khams 'byor pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho la/ /dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur mar= /ji ltar bzhed pa'i don kun 'bad med par/ /smon lam dbang bsgyur gang la gang 'dul ba'i/

/'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par don mdzad ma/ /'dod pa kun stsol khyod la= /stobs sogs yon tan gzhal du med pa yis/ /rab gang rtag tu phan bde spro ba dang*/ /srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad 'bab pa'i gnas/ /chu gter dang mtshungs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grangs med brjod las 'das pa mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /bye ba phrag brgyas lhag bcas khrag khrig zung*/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal khyod kyi pho nyar sprul/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi bdag mor= /sum cu rtsa bdun 'khor los sgyur ma'i sku/ /myos byed ri bo mda' dang yon tan grangs/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes ngo bor sdom mkhas ma/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ / nyes byas thams cad snying nas so sor bshags/ /yi rangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bskul/ /rtag tu bzhugs gsol dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /dkyil 'khor gtso mo dpa' bo dpa' mo dang*/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas dbang gi lha mo la/ /ji srid byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bla med theg par bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /dbang bzhi mnos shing dam tshig lam la gnas/ /byin rlabs rgyud sbyangs rim pa gnyis la slob/ /ngo mtshar spyod pa gsum gyi rol ba sogs/ /mtha' dag lam rnams bdag gis bsten par bgyi/ /ting 'dzin brtan cing 'phrin las thogs med 'grub/ /pho nya gsum 'dus grub pa brgyas sogs thob/ /'gro ba'i don spyod mthu dang ldan pa yi/ /tshe 'dir he ru ka dpal thob par shog /

de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma rnams kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ na gau ha da ku las sha lnga/ mu bi ma shu ra las bdud rtsi lnga rnams hūṃ bruṃ khaṃ dzriṃ aṃ ye shes lnga'i ngo bos mtshan pa rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ zhu zhing khol/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te bstim pas/ gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥ hrīḥ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ/ ādya nutpanna twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan lngas dbul/ badzra yo gī ni arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / zhes pa nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ / des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor chog go / oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥphaiṃ badzra a ralli ho/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyi mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog go /bum pa'i mchod pa gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul bcings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ e e yongs su gyur pa las/

zhes pa nas/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ shapta 'i bar brjod/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe ra ṇi ta nas/ a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la bzhon nas song bas/ bum nang gi rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas/ bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ de nas bzlas pa byed/ oṃ sumbha sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'ang bzlas/ mchod bstod rnams gong bzhin bya'o/ / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ / dung chos kyi chu bum par blug / oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi rje btsun ma 'od du zhu nas/ bum pa'i chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ dung chos kyi chu blangs la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes khrus byas la/ slob ma la bya ba ltar bdag 'jug rdzogs par blangs/ khyed rang gi zhes pa dang*/ khyed kyi zhes pa dang*/ khyed rang rnams zhes pa rnams bdag gi zhes pa dang*/ bdag nyid ces 'don pa spo/ de nas slob ma rnams la chab btang me tog bskyed bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis chos bshad/ maṇḍal 'bul bar bskul/ slob mas kyang tshom bu g.yon bskor du bkod la/

oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūṃ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūṃ/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyi bskor ba/ hūṃ dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba lang spyod/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su ma mchis pa la 'jug pa'i chos 'khor bcas zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces maṇḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / nas/ 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad dag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas grub par shog / ces rgyun bshags lan gsum brjod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/

/ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni ngais mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ / byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ / dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/

/thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*/ / zhes lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung*/ oṃ tsakṣuḥbandha wa ra a ma na ye hūṃ/ zhes mig dar btang*/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gis me tog gtad/ bum chus slob ma la gtor la suṃ bha sa bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ bdud rtsi sbyin/ bu khyod su yin gang la dga' zhes dri/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / zhes rjes bzlos bya/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dri/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / zhes rjes bzlos bya/ slob ma'i snying khar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po bsgom du bcug nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da yā mi/ zhes rjes bzlos byar bcug /rdo rje snying khar gtugs pas brtan par byas par bsgoms shig byas la/ slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje gtugs la/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / zhes gsang bar gdams/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug /ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du mos pa 'di bzhin mdzod byas la/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i baṃ yig las 'od byung*/ khyed rang gi lte bar thim/ 'od 'dus pa las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs baṃ yig zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus thams cad gang*/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i skad cig las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/

sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang*/ mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hreṃ hriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ rnams gsal btab la rjes bzlos mdzod/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su ma mchis pas bdag la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas ting lo slob ma'i khar sbyin la/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i baṃ yig las ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rnam pa mun sel gyi ting lo 'od gsal ba byung*/ khyed rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas rgyud/ lte ba'i baṃ yig dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma mtshon gang bar 'gyur/ des bde ba chen po'i gar mdzad/ chos 'byung gi grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi g.yon du 'khor/ smin mtshams dang gsang sgor yang dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon du 'khor/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon nas/ khyed rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo dam par byin gyis brlabs/ rol chen bya/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ oṃ badzra ā be sha aḥ ye shes phab pa'i rgyun de spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas brtan par mos mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra lan gnyis/ mdun bskyed rdo rje rnal 'byaur ma'i sku la me tog phul bar mos la/ me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes bzlos gyis byas la/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ slar yang me tog de nyid rang gi spyi bor bcing par mos shig byas la/

oṃ pra ti grihṇa twaṃ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dang khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong ba yang*/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hri traṃ/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig / ces lan gsum rjes bzlos kyi gsol ba btab/ rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du/ gdugs dkar po mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha sprul te/ dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad par mos shig byas la/ bum pa bzung*/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba/ /ha ha'i gad mos sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bdud kyi klad pa 'gems/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /e waṃ mnyam par sbyar ba bde ba'i sku/ /ā li kā li rol ba'i gsung mnga' zhing*/ /aṃgi ngo bo son pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ /shes rab phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ / ces shis pa brjod/ dbang lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ de nas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi nas/ de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ oṃ tsakra wī ra st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni ye/

badzra warṇa nī ye/ mahā mu ku ṭa ho/ oṃ badzri bha wa a ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ba g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna bar g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ de nas brtan bzhugs su gsol ba'i mos pa gyis byas la/ rol chen dang bcas slob ma la me tog gtor la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas lung ni/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kha'i baṃ yig las sngags rnams kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying kha'i gzungs sngags la thim pas sngags nus pa mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlab par mos la 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod byas la/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ dam bca' ba'i lung 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod byas la/ bla ma dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su ma mchis pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub sny-ing po la mchis kyi bar du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gzungs sngags nyin re la ci nus bzla bar dam 'cha' lags so/ /

slob dpon la me tog gtor la 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / me tog de nyid slar yang khyed rang rnam pa'i spyi bor gtor bas sngags 'phreng gi rnam pas snying khar thim ste/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod byas la/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bo dang snying khar gtor te/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa khyed kyi rgyud la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung rig sngags kyi byin rlabs dang*/ nus mthu ma lus pa yongs su 'jug par gyur cig / ces brjod do/ /des bum dbang thob pas bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang bar byas so/ /mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang ba nas thon/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ de nyid lce thog tu bzhag par mos shig / ces oṃ gsum ma'i mthar 'bru gsum brjod cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang mchod nas blangs la slob ma la sbyin/ des gsang dbang thob pas/ lam rang lus la brten nas rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i thabs sgom pa la dbang ngo*/ / de nas sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las sindhū ra slob dpon gyi 'theb srin g.yon pas blangs la/ slob ma'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba rnams su byugs/ 'bru gsum brjod/ de ltar gnas bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu bas/ dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes skyes par mos la/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i rjes bzlos gyis/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa dang 'khyud rgya byar bcug / des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i zhu bde de nyid dper byas te/

don rang sems bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i don sgom pa ni bzhi pa'i ye shes te/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /stong pa nyid ni rnam par sgom/ / zhes pa yin pas spros bral bde stong la cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ lam de kho na nyid dngos su sgom pa la dbang ngo*/ / de nas rjes ni slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūṃ nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su ma mchis pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / ces maṇḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ / ces yon 'bul lo/ /tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba ni/ bdag 'jug gi snga phyi gnyis dang*/ skabs 'di gsum gang la byas kyang rung ba las/ dang po gnyis ltar gtso che na'ang*/ deng sang phyi ma ltar mdzad do/ /lhag gtor dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dus gcig la gtong*/ de nas rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du*/ zhes pa nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar bum bskyed ltar mchod bstod rnams byed/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa tshe 'di nyid la stsal du gsol/

gal te tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i skal ba med na/ 'chi tshe mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhu/ de nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes sku/ /'gro la brtse bas rjes chags lha mo'i skur/ /ston mdzad rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs bcas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag 'khrul bas sngon bsags sdig kun dang*/ /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba gang bgyis pa/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i drung du mthol lo bshags/ /'gyod cing slan chad sdom par bgyid lags so/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig tshul bzhin ma bsgrubs dang*/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhis gos pa dang*/ /sbom po brgyad sogs nyes pa gang lags pa/ /dri bral lha mo'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /thun bzhi'i bstan 'dzin chag gam nor ba dang*/ /bzlas pa'i bya ba 'khrul dang cho ga nyams/ /gus pa lhod dang rnam g.yengs dbang gyur dang*/ /nyon mongs drag po'i dbang gyur mthol= /rgyun dang khyad par gza' ba'i dam tshig la/ /ngan par rtog dang brnyas dang 'gom pa dang*/ /tshes bcu'i mchod dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa sogs/ /ngan cing dus su ma mthong = /phyag rgya gzhon pa mtshon cha mtshan ma dang*/ /lhag ma 'gom dang dam can lha tshogs brnyas/ /sngags dang lha dang rgyud tshig dri med la/ /kyal ka byas sogs nongs pa= /shes rab rigs la smad dang brdeg pa dang*/ /bskor dang phyag 'tshal la sogs ma 'grub dang*/ ma dad nyon mongs rang dgar chags pa dang*/ /rang gzhan bde chen rgyu nyams= /rdo rje rnam pa gsum gyi dam tshig dang*/ /thun mong ma yin dam tshig brgyad po dang*/ / dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnam bzhi dang*/ /'gal bar gyur pa thams cad= /snod ma yin la gsang ba bsgrags pa dang*/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs rigs sngags sbyin pa dang*/

/'os min 'phrin las gsol dang gnas min par/ /sngags rgyud sbyor ba byas sogs mthol lo bshags/ /bshags dang bshags bya bshags par byed po bral/ /'dzin pa dag phyir dag tshangs phul bas kyang*/ /sgrib gnyis rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag pa'i/ /gnas lugs rtogs nas sangs rgyas thob par shog /oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka zhes sogs he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa dang*/ yo byad ma tshang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad lhag chad kha bskang zhing*/ bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rten sku 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa ma byung gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang*/ dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs sin dhu ra'i ye shes pa gshegs/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sumbha lan gnyis kyi/

tshams rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba byed do/ /de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod nas/ brjod pa dang grag pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam par rtog pa thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul du rnam par dag pa yin no/ / de nas smon lam ni/ bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur ba'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*/ /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus brtan/ /rdo rje phag mo dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang*/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos don rtogs pa dang*/ /go ku shu kra la sogs rtag bza' zhing*/ /mthar thug bde chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /bde gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi/ /dam bcas bsrung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol bar/ /thugs dam bcas shing rtag bsrung dngos grub ni/ /rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog /lha mo tshad ma nas/ rgyur gyur cig / ces smon lam btab/ de nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ chos kun gdod nas rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi yi gzugs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka /shes rab rang bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rim lnga'i lam las mchog brnyes dril bu pa/ / rig pa'i brtul zhugs legs spyod ḍeṃ gi pa/

/mu stegs 'dul mdzad bar ma'i slob dpon zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / 'khor 'das ro mnyam rnal 'byor tilli pa/ /dregs ldan che dgu'i gtsug rgyan nā ro pa/ /grags pa nam mkha'i mthar son a des pa/ / gsol ba= /blo ldan dam pa klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ /slob dpon mchog gis rjes bzung sgra bsgyur mal/ /mthu stobs mgon pos byin rlabs sa skya pa/ / gsol ba= / gsang sngags rgyud sde'i mthar son rje btsun mched/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i mthar thug kun dga'i mtshon/ /dam chos 'khor los sgyur ba 'phags pa'i zhabs/ / gsol ba= /mtha' yas gdams pa'i mnga' bdag dkon mchog dpal/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin bstan pa'i brag phug pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /gsol ba=/ chos bzhin lhur mdzad dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan yon tan mang pos brgyan/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i 'phrin las bzang po can/ /gsol ba= /zab don rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag shākya'i mtshan/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug gzhon nu chos grub zhabs/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba spangs pa'i grol mchog rje/ /gsol ba= / yang chos rje bla ma'i rjes su/ chos bzhin spyod mdzad mchod rten dkar po ba/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshul khrims 'dzin/ /blo gros chos skyong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ / gsol ba= /zab don rgya mtsho'i sogs gong bzhin/ mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /chos kun bdag po rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / thub pa'i bstan la rnam dag bslab pa gsum/ /legs mnos rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa dang*/ /byang chub sems bskyed pha rol phyin drug sogs/ /theg mchog lam la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ khyad par gsang ba'i theg pa bla med du/ / dbang bzhis smin byas rnam dag dam tshig bsrung*/

/rdo rje slob dpon mchog dang lhag pa'i lhas/ /yang dag ye shes 'pho bar= /dag snang lha yi 'khor lo 'jug pa'i sgo/ /kun rdzob snang zhen sbyong ba'i thabs kyi mchog /zab mo snying po'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa las/ /rab 'byams dngos grub 'grub par= /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor bgrang yas rnams/ /don dam lhan cig skyes par nges bsdoms pa/ /bde chen tsaṇḍa li dang mnyam sbyor pa'i/ /rdzogs rim ye shes rtogs par= /lam 'di sgrub la bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /mtha' dag nyer 'tsho phun tshogs kun sgrub nas/ /rdo rje pho nya gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yis/ /lam gyi grogs mchog sgrub par byin= /'khor lo rnam bzhi'i bgrod pa rnam dag nas/ /bcu gnyis sa yi rim pas legs bgrod pa'i/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / de nas bkra shis ni/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i padmor rdo rje rol par mdzad/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar/ /sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed gdan la bde bar bzhugs/ /rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig gsang chen zab mo'i don ston pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro grangs med gsung gi snying po sum cu gnyis/ /sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'du can/ /bden pa= /bkra shis gang zhig 'gyur med lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings/ khams gsum kun la bde ba chen pos khyab pa'i thugs/ / tshad med yon tan 'phrin las tshogs kyi nyer 'bar ma/ /bden pa des kyang = / bkra shis gang zhig zhing skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs 'joms zhi rgyas dbang gi las mdzad cing*/

/bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rgya chen rtag tu brtan gyur pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog / dus rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gong du bstan pa rnams dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba ste/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gis chog go /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ /kun gyi rtsa bar rab grags pa/ /lhan cig skyes dga' thob pa'i thabs/ /snying po'i yi ge bla na med/ /rmad byung sdeb legs 'od brgya'i ro mo bkra/ /mchog dang thun mong sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi gnas/ /rim gnyis ge sar snying po bzhad pa'i dpal/ /mchod chog 'dab brgya'i dga' ston ci yang shar/ /de las dge ba'i chu klung brgya/ /mtha' dag 'gro la nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /lhan cig skyes sku rgya mtsho yi/ /klong du bde bar son gyur cig /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga ngag 'don 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan kun khyab zung 'jug ye shes ni/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi srog tu rtag bzhugs kyang*/ /ma rtogs 'gro ba rnams kyi sgrib bsal phyir/ / rdo rje 'dzin pas chos tshul mtha' yas gsungs/ /sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal dngos grub rlabs 'phreng 'khrigs/ / zab don nor bu'i phung pos gang ba las/ /rmad byung cho ga'i sbyor ba 'dir 'ongs pa/ /chu gter bsrubs la zla ba gsar pa bzhin/ /gang las dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas rnams/ /bskyed mdzad shes rab pha rol phyin ma ni/ /rdo rje btsun mo 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i/ /sgrub thabs mchod chog rnam par dag pa 'di/ /skal ldan 'gro la dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /bgrang yas glegs bam snang brnyan 'bad med du/ /spel bar bya phyir lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /par gyi 'phrul 'khor mi zad chos sbyin bsgrubs/ / par yig mkhas pa u rgyan rdo rje dang*/ /'du byed phul phyin bkra shis 'brug rgyal dang*/ /bstan 'dzin jo bo bsam 'grub rnams yin te/
/gang 'di'i mthun rkyen ma lus sbyor ba po/ /

dad pa'i nor dang blo gros rtsal ldan pa'i/ /lhas bsrung thog rgod rdo rje zhes bya bas/ / gcig tu rnam par dkar ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'bad pas bsgrubs/ /'di las rgya chen dge ba gang 'grub pa/ /srid zhi'i legs byas kun dang lhan cig tu/ /yongs su zhugs las mtha' dag 'gro ba kun/ /bla med rgyal pa'i sa la 'khod par shog /las 'dir 'bad rtsol 'brail pa can kun dang*/ /dge ba sgrub po rang nyid sngon 'gro ba'i/ /skye bo srid gsum lam la gnas pa kun/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du yang*/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod rgyas pa dang*/ /bdud kyi las dang mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /bsam don dge ba thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog/ // dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga ngag 'don bzhugs/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 37 -- PAGE 1 -
